138F7272.source: void_volatile, the status of a target made volatile
138F7272.evidence: Shadowkeep has no status of this key. Its one status that a Void ability hit attaches and that explodes on further damage is the Void Detonator of Controlled Demolition, key 5A21565F on the status owner of entity 80BC3363, which Resupply reads.
